name: Sanketh Kamath

projects.title: Game-theoretic approaches to AI alignment

projects.text: Research on regret minimization in large games, equilibrium computation, and incentive design for multi-agent LLM training.

projects.title: Market microstructure: order-flow toxicity and trade-signing
projects.sub: An empirical study of adverse selection in US equities.
bullets: Measured adverse selection on 10.7M US equity orders across 5 tickers and 29 days using post-trade markouts and block-bootstrapped confidence intervals.

Benchmarked Lee-Ready, tick, quote, and EMO rules against ground-truth labels; found errors concentrate in a narrow near-mid band where Lee-Ready's 98% accuracy hides a reversal of the market maker's “quote/no-quote” decision.

Showed the standard (1-2p) attenuation correction fails: non-uniform errors mean global shrinkage reprices unaffected states and understates true adverse selection exactly where market makers get picked off.

projects.title: Deep learning for infant kidney ultrasound
projects.sub: Machine learning research internship, Children's National Hospital.
bullets: Developed a WideResNet model to detect hydronephrosis in infants with PyTorch and MONAI, reaching 92% accuracy on kidney ultrasound data.
Fine-tuned generative models such as Stable Diffusion and StyleGAN3 to generate scientifically accurate images of syndromic infants, enlarging the dataset for classification models by 18%.
